senses.gloss: f. (בָּעָה) search, begging, the appearance of the poor for their share in the crop. Pl. אַבְעָיוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:5">Peah IV, 5</cite> <he>ג׳ אב׳ וכ׳</he> (Y. ed. IV, 3 <he>אוּבְ׳</he>) three times a day the poor would come (cmp. etym. Y. ib. 18ᵇ top). [Oth. comment. ref. to etym. in Y. l. c. a.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Obadiah 1:6">Targ. Ob. I, 6</cite>: “the owner appears” &c.]
